summary: United Microelectronics Corp filed a 6-K reporting the disposal of 2,896,036 common shares of Novatek Microelectronics Corporation at an average price of NTD 479.8 per share, for a total of NTD 1,389,518,072 (approximately USD 43M). The transaction occurred June 17-18, 2026, and is described as a shares conversion of zero-coupon exchangeable bonds due 2026. No board resolution or counterparty relationship was disclosed. The disposal resulted in a NTD 1,007,168,830 impact on retained earnings (no net income impact). After the trade, UMC holds 12,373,857 shares (2.03%) of Novatek. This is a routine bond conversion and securities sale, not a transformative special situation.
